Romapāda
------------------------------------------
Romapāda—also known as Lomapāda—was a king of चन्द्रवṁश or lunar dynasty. He was a good friend of दशरथ, the king of अयोध्या. He is said to have adopted Śāntā, the daughter of दशरथ as his daughter and later, married her to the sage ऋष्यशृङ्ग.
Once there was a terrible famine in his kingdom. He then managed to bring the sage to his capital. As soon as the sage entered his kingdom there was heavy rain (vide Rāmāyaṇa 1.9.11; Bhāgavata 9.23).
